common_blueprint_cells: source-by-easiness quartile from the mean of the two owner-half item intercepts

direct_source_shift_attribution.definition: exact additive source contribution to cross-fitted family mean anchor-minus-full score shift
direct_source_shift_attribution.descriptive_support_rule: pooled main replication >=70%, exact binomial p<=.05, and >=2 of 3 source-rich main benchmarks individually >=65%
direct_source_shift_attribution.selection: two most negative and two most positive discovery-fold contributions per family; confirm sign in the swapped fold
direct_source_shift_attribution.status: mechanism-adjacent secondary analysis added after the frozen primary item-stability test passed

family_models: reuse the frozen owner_cap_5 baseline audit models
owner_split: reuse the frozen owner-disjoint discovery/validation halves
permutation: shuffle validation item signatures within common blueprint cells
primary_gate: at least 3 of all 5 benchmarks pass all three stability thresholds and their one-sided permutation tests

source_validation.centering_audit_note: family-mean centering was added after a preliminary 48/48 sign result was flagged as potentially containing global family offsets; the primary item-stability protocol and results were unchanged
source_validation.content_gate: pooled validation sign replication >=70% with exact binomial p<=.05, and >=2 of 3 source-rich main benchmarks individually replicate >=65%
source_validation.effect_centering: subtract each owner-half family's all-item mean before source selection and sign confirmation

winogrande_role: retained in the all-five stability gate despite its null primary near-tie excess
